title: Nifty.help
tagline: A very short introduction to NFTs
description: This is a very short website giving a very short introduction to NFTs, or Niftys as they are more affectionately known. This site is meant to be the kind of guide you could even show to your grandparents to help them understand how technology is changing. Technology, whilst sometimes complicated, usually tries to solve a specific need, and so if the 'why' can be explained, it is usually a lot easier for people to 'get it'.
how_its_made:
React. AWS. TypeScript.

I added a backend as well (check my github) which gets an image from ipfs and displays it on the frontend as a 3D model, however, I had to take that out because of a few render issues. I am also waiting on a couple of other teams for a few things before some extra functionality will work.
